seoTitle: Osceola School District Calendar 2026-2027: Holidays, Breaks & PDF
pageHeading: Osceola School District Calendar 2026-2027 (The School District of Osceola County)
seoDescription: Osceola School District 2026-2027 calendar with Aug 10 first day, May 26 last day, Rodeo Day, Spring Break, emergency make-up days, PDF and ICS.
heroSummary: The School District of Osceola County, Florida, also known as SDOC, begins the 2026-2027 school year on Monday, August 10, 2026. The final day is Wednesday, May 26, 2027. Spring Break runs Mar 15, 2027-Mar 19, 2027. Classes resume after Winter Break on Jan 4, 2027. This page explains the SDOC traditional calendar, family planning dates, calendar terms, and official download options.
calendarNotes: The School District of Osceola County starts the 2026-2027 school year for students on Monday, August 10, 2026 and ends the student year on Wednesday, May 26, 2027. Thanksgiving student holidays run November 23-27, Winter Break runs December 21-January 1 with classes resuming January 4, and Spring Break runs March 15-19 with classes resuming March 22. The calendar lists October 12 and January 8 as teacher workdays/student holidays or emergency make-up days, and notes that additional emergency make-up days may be assigned based on the circumstances.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Osceola County school start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school for Osceola County students is Monday, August 10, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Osceola County in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Wednesday, May 26, 2027, which is also the end of the fourth grading period.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Winter Break for Osceola County schools in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 21, 2026 through Friday, January 1, 2027. Classes resume Monday, January 4, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Osceola Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 15 through Friday, March 19, 2027. Classes resume Monday, March 22.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are in the Osceola 2026-2027 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official 2026-2027 Osceola school calendar lists 180 pupil days and 190 teacher days.

calendarFaqs.q: Which 2026-2027 Osceola dates are emergency make-up days?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar marks October 12, 2026 and January 8, 2027 as teacher workdays/student holidays or emergency make-up days. It also notes that additional emergency make-up days may be assigned if needed.

customSections.label: Osceola Calendar Track Information
customSections.content: This page summarizes the School District of Osceola County 2026-2027 traditional student calendar. Specialized programs, PATHS, athletics, testing, graduation, and campus events may publish separate schedules, so families should verify program-specific dates with the school or district.

customSections.label: Understanding SDOC Calendar Labels
customSections.content: The Osceola school calendar is more useful when families understand what each label means. Some no-school dates are simple holidays, while others are teacher workdays, professional learning days, or emergency make-up dates that may change if the district needs to recover instructional time.

rows: Student Holiday
Students do not attend school. Families should still check whether staff work, campus events, or programs have separate schedules.
Teacher Workday
Students stay home while staff complete planning, grading, or required work. Osceola lists October 12 and January 8 as teacher workdays that may also become emergency make-up days.
Emergency Make-Up Day
A scheduled student holiday or teacher workday may become an instructional day if weather closures or other emergencies require make-up time.
Professional Learning Day
Teachers receive training while students are off. Families should treat these dates like no-school days for childcare planning.
Rodeo Day
A local Osceola County student holiday in February. It is not a federal holiday, so families new to the district should add it separately.
No Early Release Wednesday
The district identifies specific Wednesdays when the normal early-release pattern does not apply.

customSections.label: Osceola Family Planning Guide
customSections.content: Use the SDOC calendar as a family decision guide, not only as a date list. Osceola families often need to coordinate school breaks with tourism work schedules, commute corridors, childcare, emergency make-up days, and program-specific calendars.

groups.label: Before the school year starts
items: Add the August 10 first student day to your calendar and confirm bus, car-line, or after-school routines.
Check whether your student follows the traditional district calendar or a program-specific schedule such as PATHS.
Review October 12 and January 8 before treating them as fixed student holidays because both are marked as possible emergency make-up days.

groups.label: Before major breaks
items: Confirm return dates after Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, and Spring Break before booking camps or travel.
Reserve childcare early for Rodeo Day and teacher workdays because those dates may not align with standard workplace holidays.
Families tied to theme-park, resort, restaurant, healthcare, logistics, or shift-based work should check work calendars against SDOC no-school days.

groups.label: During weather or schedule changes
items: Watch official Osceola Schools announcements during hurricane season before assuming emergency make-up days remain no-school days.
Re-check campus communications for testing, graduation, athletics, and school-specific events because they are not fully covered by the districtwide academic calendar.

customSections.label: What Changed This Year for Osceola Families
customSections.content: The year-to-year date changes matter most when they affect childcare, work schedules, and emergency planning. Use this summary with the official Osceola calendar before treating teacher workdays or travel windows as final.

rows: First student day moves to August 10, 2026
Back-to-school childcare, transportation routines, and work coverage begin earlier than the previous school year.
High
Confirm transportation, after-school care, and first-week work coverage before August.
Last student day moves to May 26, 2027
Summer camp, travel, and work-schedule planning should use the May 26 student end date rather than assuming a later final week.
Medium
Use May 26 as the student end date when reserving summer programs or travel.
Emergency make-up notes shift to October 12 and January 8
Do not treat those teacher workdays as fixed no-school days until Osceola confirms whether emergency make-up time is needed.
High
Verify district announcements before booking childcare or travel around these dates.
Rodeo Day remains a local February student holiday
Families new to Osceola should add Rodeo Day separately because it may not align with standard workplace holidays.
Medium
Add February 19 to family and work calendars as a local student holiday.

whatsNew.title: Changes from the 2025-2026 Calendar
content: The first student day moves from August 11 in 2025 to August 10 in 2026.
The last student day moves from May 28 in 2026 to May 26 in 2027.
Emergency make-up day notes shift to October 12, 2026 and January 8, 2027.
